Sandbox_PhunZones_Widget_tooltip: Displays a moveable widget that displays the current zones title and subtitle. It can also show pips that signify the danger level for the current zone
Sandbox_PhunZones_ShowDifficulty_tooltip: Show difficulty level for zone as pips in widget. Requires Show Widget to be ticked.
Sandbox_PhunZones_MaxDifficulty_tooltip: Maximum number of difficulty. This is the max number of pips in your widget (default is 4)
Sandbox_PhunZones_UpdateInterval_tooltip: The number of seconds between scanning for zone changes. 1 should be more than fine
Sandbox_PhunZones_Debug_tooltip: Increase verbosity of logging to help diagnose issues. Best to leave off otherwise
Sandbox_PhunZones_EditorRole_tooltip: If set, only players whose role name matches this value (case-insensitive) can open the zone editor. Leave empty to allow all players that have access to admin/debug menu (or always allow in singleplayer).
Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt_tooltip: When on, staff are not blocked by a zone's No Building, No Placing, No Pickup, No Scrapping, No Destruction, No Safehouse or No Players settings. By itself this covers the Admin role only - tick 'Include Moderator and GM' to widen it. No Fire is never exempted: fire has no owner to check.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ExemptModGM_tooltip: Extends 'Staff ignore zone restrictions' to the Moderator, GM and Overseer roles as well as Admin. Has no effect unless that option is on.
